messages:
Morgan: quick heads-up — kickoff with OmniScale today. They want a Q3 dedicated commit + burst arrangement. Ballpark from sales: expected peak = 120k GPU-hours/month, steady = ~65k GPU-hours/month. They need eu-west primary, ap-south failover, p99 latency target 99.9% for short-chat flows.
Anika: got it. do we have recent utilization curves for similar customers? 120k peak -> what VM types + gpus are we assuming?
Devin: for Dedicated we usually map 120k GPU-hours/mo -> ~166 GPUs sustained (24/7) if single-GPU machines. But customers want headroom for microbursts. recommend commit = 140k (17% buffer) + 20% burst credits.
Sasha: flag: ap-south capacity is tight for the next 6 weeks (vendor deliveries delayed). if they need failover there we should plan limits or region routing fallback to eu-central.
Morgan: sales pushed for lower upfront commit to keep cost down. can we present 2 options: (A) 140k commit + 20% bursts, (B) 110k commit + 40% burst credits + dynamic cross-region fallback? need cost and outage-risk delta.
Anika: I'll draft the two options. quick math snippet:
```
Option A: commit 140k GPU-hours/mo -> monthly cost = commit_rate * 140k + overage_rate * actual_overage
Buffer headroom = (140k - 120k)/120k = 16.6%
Burst pool = 0.20 * 140k = 28k GPU-hours
Option B: commit 110k, burst pool 40% -> burst = 44k GPU-hours, but commit headroom negative if sustained >110k
```
Devin: operational notes: if we give big burst pool we need to reserve warm-pool instances to hit p99 latency. cold starts will burn the burst pool quickly. also KV cache warms slower across region failovers.
Sasha: network egress cost when failing over to eu-central for ap-south traffic will add ~8-12% to token egress cost for that customer. include that in pricing model.
Morgan: can we model expected burn pattern? sales gave hourly profile sample (daytime peak 3x nighttime). if steady=65k and peak=120k, bursts happen mostly 09:00–18:00 local.
Anika: I'll run a quick Monte Carlo sim with diurnal profile + 30% variability and produce expected monthly burn percentiles. goal: find commit that keeps 95% of months within commit+burst without exceeding burst pool by >10%.
capacity-bot: capacity-check: eu-west available sustained GPUs (snap): 230 GPUs free, current reserved earmarks: 42 GPUs, projected deliveries next 30d: +60 GPUs. ap-south available sustained GPUs: 18 GPUs free, pending delivery: +8 GPUs in 4w.
ops-oncall: note: if we promise large burst in ap-south we should add an SLA clause about cross-region redirection and expected additional latency of ~30–80ms. ops will require a canary and staged rollout.
Devin: recommendation for discussion doc: Option A (preferred for reliability) and Option B (lower commit for price-sensitive). include table: cost delta, p99 risk, network delta, warming overhead.
Morgan: perfect. Anika — can you upload the simulation by EOD? I'll sync with sales and legal for draft contract buffer language (explicit burst exhaustion behavior).
